'''Pikachu Shocks Back issue 2''' is the sixth monthly issue of the manga series [[The Electric Tale of Pikachu]] to be released by [[VIZ Media]]. It contains the sixth chapter of the manga, ''[[ET06|To Evolve or Not to Evolve, That Is the Question!]]''. 

The contents of this issue were included as part of {{vol|Electric Tale of Pikachu|2}} along with [[ET05]], [[ET07]], and [[ET08]].

* Mikey (and Ash) are challenged to a battle against his brothers after not evolving his Eevee for The Knights of the E Stone.
* Mikey and Ash win the battle.
* Mikey and Ash are accepted into The Knights of the E Stone, although Ash refuses.
